verdict.rationale: The Sai API uses a versioned path (`POST /v1/agents/message`, `/v1/agents/approve`), and the docs mark a legacy desktop automation surface as deprecated and 'kept for reference and migration only.' That shows some versioning and deprecation labeling, but no formal deprecation policy is documented. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (timelines, notice periods, sunset guarantees), an explicit API versioning or changelog scheme, a published OpenAPI spec (all probe paths returned 404), and independent corroboration.
